Orpo: Orpo (n.): A Finnish Prime Minister who is remarkably adept at presiding over a country's economic stagnation while simultaneously facilitating its gradual surrender to China, all without noticeably batting an eyelash.
Purra: Purra (n.): A government official whose "innovative" idea of linking social benefits to free labor is so draconian it makes you question the morality of calling it a democracy.
Cat: Cat (n.): A symbol of uninterrupted sleep, now forever elusive in a world where even bears can't get a good night's rest due to bureaucratic shenanigans.
